Entries.Title: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien
Entries.Description: Ben's secret is out. As Ben deals with his newfound fame, a new threat emerges as a thief steals parts of a new advanced spaceship from NASA.

Episodes.Title: Fame
Episodes.Description: Ben's secret is out. As Ben deals with his newfound fame, a new threat emerges as a thief steals parts of a new advanced spaceship from NASA.

Episodes.Title: Duped
Episodes.Description: Ben is supposed to attend a tournament to support his girlfriend, but the Forever Knights are trying to break into a museum. Ben tries to use the Ultimatrix to handle all his obligations.

Episodes.Title: Hit 'Em Where They Live
Episodes.Description: After Jimmy Jones reveals Ben's identity, some of his enemies (such as Zombozo, Rojo, Charmcaster, Vulkanus, and Sevenseven) team up to try to attack his family. Now Ben and his friends have to protect them no matter what.

Episodes.Title: Video Games
Episodes.Description: Ben gets an offer to star in his own video game, but the designer's real motives are part of a plan to destroy Ben.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Aggregor
Episodes.Description: The team encounters another alien who escaped from Aggregor and, through him, learns more about Aggregor's goals.

Episodes.Title: Too Hot to Handle
Episodes.Description: P'Andor, escaped from Aggregor, now wants help to escape his encapsulating suit, but Kevin's the first to perceive that that's a fatally bad idea.

Episodes.Title: Andreas' Fault
Episodes.Description: Then team encounters another of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, Andreas, whom Argit is using as part of a scheme against the Forever Knights.

Episodes.Title: Fused
Episodes.Description: Ra'ad, the last of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, attacks Ben and informs the team of the true fate of his comrades. He finds a safe hiding place but one that endangers Ben in the process.

Episodes.Title: Hero Time
Episodes.Description: Ben meets his hero, Captain Nemesis, who's become jealous of all the attention Ben attracts.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Aggregor
Episodes.Description: Aggregor has all five aliens. The Plumbers manage to disable Aggregor's ship, forcing Aggregor to find a new way to absorb their powers. The team makes a last ditch effort to save the alien prisoners.

Episodes.Title: Map of Infinity
Episodes.Description: Aggregor has absorbed all the powers of his captured aliens. Now he's after the Map of Infinity.

Episodes.Title: Reflected Glory
Episodes.Description: Cash and JT convince the team to allow them to take credit for the team's actions so they can earn money for Cash's mother's operation.

Episodes.Title: Deep
Episodes.Description: Aggregor is after the next piece of the map on a watery planet.

Episodes.Title: Where the Magic Happens
Episodes.Description: Aggregor escapes to a magical dimension. Gwen asks for Charmcaster's help to pursue him. The team learns about Charmcaster's past and why she's willing to help them now.

Episodes.Title: Perplexhahedron
Episodes.Description: With the fourth piece of the Map of Infinity almost in Aggregor's clutches, the gang chase him through the artificial planetoid known as Perplexahedron.

Episodes.Title: The Forge of Creation
Episodes.Description: As the team makes its final attempt to stop Aggregor, they find an unexpected ally, and one person will make a fateful decision with lasting repercussions.

Episodes.Title: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
Episodes.Description: Kevin's out for payback on anyone who has ever crossed him. His next stop is a prison in the Null Void. Ben and Gwen try to stop him, where Ben comes to a grim decision.

Episodes.Title: The Enemy of My Enemy
Episodes.Description: Argit asks Ben and Gwen for protection from Kevin, so they take him to the nearest Plumbers Academy, but that won't stop Kevin.

Episodes.Title: Absolute Power (1)
Episodes.Description: Kevin starts going after Plumbers kids to gain more power. Ben and Gwen continue to argue about how to handle the situation. Gwen tries to find someone who will help her cure Kevin.

Episodes.Title: Absolute Power (2)
Episodes.Description: Final confrontation with Kevin. While Gwen makes a last ditch effort to save Kevin, Ben fights an all out battle with Kevin.

Episodes.Title: The Transmogrification of Eunice
Episodes.Description: A mysterious alien girl named Eunice has no memory and is being hunted by Sunder. While evading Sunder, Ben soon discovers that Eunice has nature-based abilities.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Beholder
Episodes.Description: Ben, Julie and the rest of the heroic crew embark on a dangerous journey that could cost them all their lives in an effort to achieve the safe return of Ship and his former owner Baz-L.

Episodes.Title: Viktor: The Spoils
Episodes.Description: The King of Zarkovia asks the team for help with a civil war. The team agrees to help when they find out Dr. Viktor may be involved.

Episodes.Title: The Big Story
Episodes.Description: Jimmy Jones is looking for the biggest new story he and Ben can tackle, but thats when he stumbles upon a strange pink tentacled creature which crashed from the sky into a near by cave.

Episodes.Title: Girl Trouble
Episodes.Description: Gwen is excited by the prospect of her cousin Sunny paying the team a visit while dealing with the Robots of Dimension 12. But her excitement quickly turns into trepidation when it is uncovered that her cousin is not all that she appears and has some particularly sinister intentions.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Swarm
Episodes.Description: Victor Validus resurfaces and attacks Ben at night. Elena Validus and the nanochips return.

Episodes.Title: The Creature from Beyond
Episodes.Description: The Forever Knights unleash an evil force mistaken for an ancient weapon.

Episodes.Title: Basic Training
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin are summoned to a Plumbers' Academy to go under training that is supervised by Magister Hulka.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Easy Being Gwen
Episodes.Description: Gwen has always been a multi-tasker, trying to juggle school, hobbies, friends and her work as a hero, waking up early and going to sleep late. But Gwen's already packed day is about to get worse when Dr. Animo attacks with an army of giant frogs and Gwen is forced to make a hard choice.

Episodes.Title: Ben 10,000 Returns
Episodes.Description: Following a visit from Paradox after a fight with Eon, Ben 10,000 arrives 20 years from the future to seek the aid of his past counterpart in tracking down Eon.

Episodes.Title: Moon Struck
Episodes.Description: Grandpa Max tells the team about his first UFO encounter, which led him to meet Verdona.

Episodes.Title: Prisoner #775 Is Missing
Episodes.Description: After a base is attacked, Max is infuriated when they learn it was a secret alien prison facility. While Max argues with the officer in charge, the team tries to locate an escaped prisoner.

Episodes.Title: The Purge
Episodes.Description: Old George, the original Forever Knight, reclaims his position, and orders the Knights to remove all aliens on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Simian Says
Episodes.Description: Simian asks the team for help when a DNAlien takes over his home world.

Episodes.Title: Greetings from Techadon
Episodes.Description: Ben faces Tecadon killer robots that have been programmed to kill him. Each robot is more powerful than the last one. Ben's only chance to survive is for Gwen to find out who commissioned the robots.

Episodes.Title: The Flame Keeper's Circle
Episodes.Description: Julie gets Ben to visit a charity organization who wants to improve the world with alien technology. Ben soon discovers the charity's benefactor is an old enemy.

Episodes.Title: Double or Nothing
Episodes.Description: Ben finds out there's a new show called 'Ben 10: Live." He finds an old enemy running the show and cashing in on his fame.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Girlfriend
Episodes.Description: Julie suddenly leaves a tennis tournament and spends all her time with Ben.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Ben's Ultimate transformations have developed their own personalities. Now they want their freedom from Ben.

Episodes.Title: The Widening Gyre
Episodes.Description: Colonel Rozum asks the team to investigate an island of garbage where people have been disappearing.

Episodes.Title: The Mother of All Vreedles
Episodes.Description: Ma Vreedle goes to Earth to expand her family by creating clones and using all the water on Earth.

Episodes.Title: A Knight to Remember
Episodes.Description: The Flame Keepers realize their mistake too late. Vilgax wants the power of Daigon. The Forever Knights are out to destroy Daigon. Ben and the team try to sort things out.

Episodes.Title: Solitary Alignment
Episodes.Description: Azmuth reveals the origin of the sword and how he first encountered Old George. Ben comes to a decision on how to handle the Daigon.

Episodes.Title: Inspector #13
Episodes.Description: A Techadon weapon master comes to Earth and wants the Ultimatrix.

Episodes.Title: The Enemy of My Frenemy
Episodes.Description: Gwen and co revisit Legerdomain in hopes of rescuing Charmcaster.

Episodes.Title: Couples Retreat
Episodes.Description: After Darkstar opens the Door to Anywhere, Charmcaster comes through, and the two team up to give Ben, Gwen, and Kevin the fight of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Catch a Falling Star
Episodes.Description: Movie starlet Jennifer Nocturne is recaptured by the evil Captain Nemesis!

Episodes.Title: The Eggman Cometh
Episodes.Description: Dr. Animo is unexpectedly paroled from prison and starts up a company selling eggs, which in fact contain mutant dinosaurs which he wishes to distribute around the world.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Living Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Albedo attempts to get the ultimatrix by invading Ben's mind.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of the End
Episodes.Description: The final battle between the Forever Knights and Dagon's Esoterica is in full swing, with Ben caught in the middle!

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Enemy (1)
Episodes.Description: Dagon is getting closer and closer to entering our dimension thanks to an old foe.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Enemy (2)
Episodes.Description: Vilgax re-emerges in his most powerful form ever! Can Ben stop him and save the universe?

Entries.Title: Ben 10: Alien Force
Entries.Description: Ben discovers that the Forever Knights are trading weapons with the DNAliens, while at the same time, Grandpa Max has mysteriously gone missing. He decides to return the Omnitrix on his wrist and go hero once again.

Episodes.Title: Ben 10 Returns (1)
Episodes.Description: Ben discovers that the Forever Knights are trading weapons with the DNAliens, while at the same time, Grandpa Max has mysteriously gone missing. He decides to return the Omnitrix on his wrist and go hero once again.

Episodes.Title: Ben 10 Returns (2)
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin follow a lead that takes them to a secret base in the desert. There they hope to find Grandpa Max but instead find a Highbreed spaceship with a giant cannon.

Episodes.Title: Everybody Talks About the Weather
Episodes.Description: Gwen discovers that Grandpa Max's badge is able to signal other Plumbers. However, by using it, they meet up with a familiar face, a pyronite.

Episodes.Title: Kevin's Big Score
Episodes.Description: Kevin shatters Ben and Gwen's trust when he steals the Rust Bucket to sell for alien technology on the black market.

Episodes.Title: All that Glitters
Episodes.Description: Grandpa Max leaves Ben a series of instructions to contact a team of heroes. Things go the wrong direction when they soon find them.

Episodes.Title: Max Out
Episodes.Description: Gwen's older brother, Ken, is suddenly missing. As they look, they encounter a surprise leading to a shocking secret from the DNAliens.

Episodes.Title: Pier Pressure
Episodes.Description: While Ben has a date with Julie, it is soon ruined when an alien named Ship makes trouble at the local fair.

Episodes.Title: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
Episodes.Description: When Ben and Gwen learn that their grandmother Verdona is an alien being, Verdona insists that Gwen should come along with her to her home planet and improve her abilities. With this, Gwen is faced with a difficult decision between a human and alien life.

Episodes.Title: The Gauntlet
Episodes.Description: When Ben stands up to Cash and JT, they soon discover a robotic gauntlet from Kevin's vehicle. With it, Cash decides to get back on Ben, although this time, it's more than just a joke.

Episodes.Title: Paradox
Episodes.Description: A time experiment in the 1950s sends a bizarre monster to Ben's time. Now Ben, Gwen, and Kevin must team up with Paradox, a time traveling hero, to face off against the unstoppable creature.

Episodes.Title: Be-Knighted
Episodes.Description: The Forever Knights secure a weapon in hopes of aiding them slay a dragon they have held captive.

Episodes.Title: Plumber's Helpers
Episodes.Description: Freelance young Plumbers mistake Ben and his team as a threat.

Episodes.Title: X = Ben + 2
Episodes.Description: An alien emperor plans to destroy the planet Earth for kidnapping his daughter. In order to save the planet, Ben must uncover the secrets of Alien X.

Episodes.Title: Darkstar Rising
Episodes.Description: A new villain comes into town, his name is Darkstar, he commits some crimes and gets the team's attention fast

Episodes.Title: Alone Together
Episodes.Description: During a battle Ben and an alien commander are teleported to a distant world. They must put their differences aside if they're going to have any chance of finding a way to return to Earth.

Episodes.Title: Good Copy, Bad Copy
Episodes.Description: An alien impersonates Ben with hopes of using his Omnitrix to annihilate him.

Episodes.Title: Save The Last Dance
Episodes.Description: Kevin asks Gwen to the school dance; Ben fears he's losing control of the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: Undercover
Episodes.Description: Cooper is kidnapped by the DNAliens, who want him to build a mystery arch.

Episodes.Title: Pet Project
Episodes.Description: To find and destroy the alien dragon species, the Forever Knights capture Ship to control a starship they built out of alien technology to locate their homeworld and destroy them.

Episodes.Title: Grounded
Episodes.Description: When Ben's parents discover his ability to turn into aliens, they forbid him from using the Omnitrix and later ground him from using it again. Eventually Gwen is grounded too leaving Kevin to stop the DNAliens.

Episodes.Title: Voided
Episodes.Description: After Gwen receives an S.O.S. from Helen, Ben must go into the Null Void to save her and Manny. Once there, he must find The Wrench in order to stop D'Void, who happens to be Ben's old enemy Dr. Animo

Episodes.Title: Inside Man
Episodes.Description: Ben and the gang rescue a runaway prisoner of the DNAliens.

Episodes.Title: Birds of a Feather
Episodes.Description: The gang helps the prince of the arachna-chimps regain power

Episodes.Title: Unearthed
Episodes.Description: Ben cares for a baby monster and helps locate its parents before the DNAliens find it.

Episodes.Title: War of the Worlds (1)
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin gather their allies to counter the threat of the incoming Highbreed fleet. Azmuth reveals a secret about the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: War of the Worlds (2)
Episodes.Description: Ben goes to the HighBreeds' world in an attempt to stop their attack on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance of Vilgax (1)
Episodes.Description: Vilgax, after conquering 10 planets, comes to Earth to destroy Ben.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance of Vilgax (2)
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin race to collect the Omnitrix's missing forms and make it to the battle with Vilgax on time. Meanwhile, Kevin discovers that his new transformation has some benefits.

Episodes.Title: Inferno
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin discover that Vulkanus is planning to drill the center of the Earth and drop a bomb into the hole. Destroying the planet.

Episodes.Title: Fool's Gold
Episodes.Description: A species of goat-like aliens comes to Earth for a popcorn festival. Ben, Gwen, and Kevin have a big problem when one of the aliens eats meat and turns into a monster.

Episodes.Title: Simple
Episodes.Description: An alien named Probity seeks help from Ben to stop the on-going war on her home planet.

Episodes.Title: Vreedle, Vreedle
Episodes.Description: Ship's owner decides he wants him back and hires some repo men to retrieve him. Ben and Kevin go to court to take care of things legally, leaving Gwen and Julie to face the repo men.

Episodes.Title: Single Handed
Episodes.Description: A bounty hunter tries to remove the Omnitrix from Ben.

Episodes.Title: If All Else Fails
Episodes.Description: A series of earthquakes awakens a HighBreed officer who has been hibernating deep under the earth’s surface. He believes the HighBreed have lost the war and activates a fail safe device that is programmed to destroy. Ben must now work together with Gwen and Kevin not only to save Grandpa Max, but also the world from this "giant" problem.

Episodes.Title: In Charm's Way
Episodes.Description: Kevin is beginning to lose all hope that he will someday return to his human self. He then meets a girl who doesn't seem to mind the form he is in. Kevin finds himself under her spell, quite literally, as Charmcaster has come back to exact revenge on Ben and Gwen. Kevin, under Charmcaster's spell, has no choice but to obey his master and destroy Ben and Gwen.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Town
Episodes.Description: Vilgax promises Ghostfreak to spring him out of prison as long as he tells him the secrets of the Omnitrix, but when Ghostfreak betrays him and turns his people into his minions, Vilgax comes to Earth and asks for Ben, Gwen and Kevin's help to get rid of Ghostfreak.

Episodes.Title: Trade-Off!
Episodes.Description: Kevin makes a temporary truce with Darkstar to retrieve an artifact that will return them into their former selves.

Episodes.Title: Busy Box
Episodes.Description: Ben, Kevin and Gwen come across an alien box that can forms into a robotic version of whatever it sees. It power becomes a liability when the Vreedle brothers decide to take the box for themselves.

Episodes.Title: Con of Rath
Episodes.Description: Zaw-Veenull asks Ben to deliver Prince Tiffin to Jarret in order to keep peace between the two species. Shortly, after their trip in space, the Omnitrix malfunctions and turns Ben into an Appoplexian named Rath who wants to fight anything that breathes.

Episodes.Title: Primus
Episodes.Description: The Omnitrix transports Ben, Gwen, and Kevin to a planet called Primus, which turns out to have been created by Azmuth.  They must stop Vilgax from stopping the Omnitrix at its source.

Episodes.Title: Time Heals
Episodes.Description: Despite being warned by Paradox, Gwen travels back in time to prevent the accident that turned Kevin into a monster from ever happening. Gwen returns to the present only to find that her time traveling caused a series of events that led to Hex ruling the world.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Chromastone
Episodes.Description: While sick, Ben is visited by old friend Tetrax, who demands that Ben hand over Chromastone.

Episodes.Title: Above and Beyond
Episodes.Description: The Plumber's Helpers are called upon by Grandpa Max to rescue him from an abandoned space station where he's being attacked by Ben! The team must now find a way to work together as they try to save Max, stop Ben, and keep the space station from crashing to Earth.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: Kevin returns home to find his house ransacked, so he enlists Ben and Gwen's help to find out who did it and why. They soon cross paths with Ragnarok, a deadly criminal who recently broke free from the Null Void and is in search of a special key. Kevin is intent on stopping Ragnarok from obtaining the special key, especially after he learns the truth about Ragnarok and his father.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle (1)
Episodes.Description: Albedo has stolen the Ultimatrix from Azmuth and has used it to kidnap Gwen and Kevin. Ben goes to face Albedo and rescue his friends when he quickly discovers that Albedo has been working in conjunction with Vilgax. Ben is defeated by the pair and gives up the Omnitrix to save himself and his friends.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle (2)
Episodes.Description: Powerless, Ben goes aboard Vilgax's ship and faces off with Vilgax to stop his invasion of Earth in their final battle. Albedo gives Ben the Ultimatrix and Ben gets his old aliens and their evolved forms.

Entries.Title: Ben 10: Omniverse
Entries.Description: After parting ways with Gwen and Kevin, Ben is assigned a new alien partner named Rook Blanko. Meanwhile, Khyber the Hunstman targets Ben as his next prey.

Episodes.Title: The More Things Change (1)
Episodes.Description: After parting ways with Gwen and Kevin, Ben is assigned a new alien partner named Rook Blanko. Meanwhile, Khyber the Hunstman targets Ben as his next prey.

Episodes.Title: The More Things Change (2)
Episodes.Description: Rook and Ben find a mysterious alien city under Bellwood after stopping 3 alien crooks: Liam, Fistina, and Bubble Helmet from blowing up Mr. Baumann's superstore in a protection racket.

Episodes.Title: A Jolt From The Past
Episodes.Description: The Megawhatts that Ben fought in his youth seek his help when they are being used as a power source for the villain Fistrick.

Episodes.Title: Trouble Helix
Episodes.Description: Infiltrating the Plumbers' base, Khyber uploads footage of young Ben's encounter with a corrupted Mechomorph named Malware.

Episodes.Title: Have I Got a Deal for You
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook must stop a giant rampaging alien from destroying Bellwood while dealing with a peace-loving alien-rights activist who doesn't want it hurt.

Episodes.Title: It Was Them
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook attempt to stop Dr Animo and his giant ants.

Episodes.Title: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies?
Episodes.Description: When Ben and Rook investigate a mysterious alien ghost ship, they discover that Argit and the Vreedle Brothers are fighting for possession of a doomsday device.

Episodes.Title: Hot Stretch
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook come across elastic, hot blooded aliens that plan to activate a volcano with a nuclear bomb engine.

Episodes.Title: Of Predators and Prey (1)
Episodes.Description: It is revealed that during a fight with Eleven-Year Old Ben Tennyson, Malware touched the Omnitrix symbol on Four Arms. After the battle, he went to Dr. Psychobos and made him create a prototype Omnitrix, the Nemetrix. Back in the present, after a heated argument, Ben and Rook go their separate ways, giving Khyber his best chance to capture Ben.

Episodes.Title: Of Predators and Prey (2)
Episodes.Description: While trapped in Khyber's ship, Khyber tells Ben that he needs different alien DNA to complete the evil incomplete version of the Omnitrix the Nemetrix. He also reveals that Dr.Psychobos assigned him to hunt down various species for DNA to transfer it to the Nemetrix.

Episodes.Title: Outbreak
Episodes.Description: The Omnitrix begins to malfunction and goes haywire when Psychobos steals a piece of an Omnitrix core causing Rook to mutate into a half-Gourmand and a half-Revonnahgander after Ben 10 attempts to complete a transformation.

Episodes.Title: Many Happy Returns
Episodes.Description: Gwen and Kevin visit Bellwood. Kevin tells Ben that he must hide himself from The Tetramand Princess Looma as she is hunting him as Looma wishes to marry Kevin.

Episodes.Title: Gone Fishin'
Episodes.Description: Magister Patelliday is kidnapped by pirates who rob ships and put them in giant glass bottles to sell them. They intend to devour Patelliday. Any attempts at rescue are hard, since they have a Krakken and a robot army.

Episodes.Title: Blukic and Driba go to Mr. Smoothy's
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook must stop Trumbipulor from gaining absolute power while Blukic and Driba set out to find Mr. Smoothy's.

Episodes.Title: Malefactor
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook are attacked by Khyber at a festival.

Episodes.Title: Arrested Development
Episodes.Description: Billy Billions turns Ben and Rook into kids again.

Episodes.Title: Bros in Space
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook visit Rook's family while Revohnnah is attacked by an old foe.

Episodes.Title: Ben Again
Episodes.Description: When Eon forces young Ben and teenage Ben to switch minds, only the time-traveling Professor Paradox can sort things out and help Ben stop Eon from taking over the timelines.

Episodes.Title: Store 23
Episodes.Description: Ben meets an alternate version of himself while searching for a 23rd Mr. Smoothy's store.

Episodes.Title: Special Delivery
Episodes.Description: As payment for destroying his car, Mr. Baumann orders Ben to make deliveries for him without using the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: Showdown (1)
Episodes.Description: Ben must deal with a past failure while a deranged Malware launches his final attack on Azmuth.

Episodes.Title: Showdown (2)
Episodes.Description: Ben must deal with a past failure; a deranged Malware launches his final attack.

Episodes.Title: Tummy Trouble
Episodes.Description: When the Incursean armada kidnaps the Gourmand Queen, Ben and Rook must get the warring Gormand factions to work together to save her and stop the Incursean invasion.

Episodes.Title: Vilgax Must Croak
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook escort Vilgax to a maximum-security prison planet, but the Incurseans have other plans.

Episodes.Title: While You Were Away
Episodes.Description: Dr. Psychobos and Princess Attea have invaded Rook's home planet Revonnah with an army of Incurseans!

Episodes.Title: The Frogs of War (1)
Episodes.Description: The Incursean Armada, with the help of Dr. Psychobos, have invaded the Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Frogs of War (2)
Episodes.Description: The Incurseans take control of Earth, so Rook and the Plumbers must mount a resistance while Ben is missing.

Episodes.Title: Rules of Engagement
Episodes.Description: Princess Looma returns to claim Ben as her husband, and she's not going to let anyone stand in her way!

Episodes.Title: Rad
Episodes.Description: With Plumber agents trapped in Incursean territory, Ben and Rook must employ the services of Rad Dudesman, the roughest, toughest smuggler in the galaxy.

Episodes.Title: Evil's Encore
Episodes.Description: Dr. Animo reminisces about when he once took control of the Plumber's HQ in Mount Rushmore.

Episodes.Title: T.G.I.S.
Episodes.Description: The Secret Saturdays come to Bellwood to help Ben and Rook investigate a rash of chupacabra attacks where they've been draining alien lifeforce.

Episodes.Title: Food Around The Corner
Episodes.Description: Ben as Gravattack attempts to moderate a fragile peace treaty, but must endure the attacks of tiny alien fleas, which have inhabited his body. Rook shrinks down in attempt to get the fleas off him before the peace treaty is ruined. But it turns out that the Lewodon named Poltroon, sent the fleas onto Gravattack to destroy his core, causing a meltdown in attempt to destroy both the Lewodons and the Appoplexians, therefore causing a war between the 2 species and taking power to destroy his enemies. Now Rook must find a way to change Ben back before they are destroyed and to stop Poltroon.

Episodes.Title: Oh, Mother Where Art Thou?
Episodes.Description: Octagon and Rhomboid Vreedle kidnap Pretty Boy Vreedle, but when Ma Vreedle finds out he's stolen, but not by whom, she threatens to blow up the sun if Ben and the Plumbers don't find her missing son! Meanwhile Ben tries to hide from his mom so he won't get seconds on the dinner that he hates.

Episodes.Title: Return to Forever
Episodes.Description: Dr. Joseph Chadwick is back as a Forever King. He is now leading the remnants of the Forever Knights who threaten to erase all alien DNA on Earth as Ben and Rook work to stop the Forever Knights. Jimmy discovers that Will Harangue is somehow involved in Joseph's plot.

Episodes.Title: Mud is Thicker Than Water
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Cousin Lucy try to find out how Psyphon's thugs are getting Plumber technology. Gwen suspects that Lucy is the mole because of all her shape-shifting abilities, and her love of tricks when she was younger.

Episodes.Title: OTTO Motives
Episodes.Description: Kevin, Rook and Argit run into OTTO, an old enemy who tricked Kevin and Argit by stranding them alone in the Null Void. While attending an intergalactic auto show on Khoros, OTTO and Violent Offenders end up stealing some of the most expensive cars, and its up to the gang to stop them with some help from Ben.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Heist
Episodes.Description: Albedo, disguised as Ben, seeks a device that will finally change him back into his Galvan form. Meanwhile, the real Ben is locked in Albedo's prison cell at Plumber HQ.

Episodes.Title: A Fistful of Brains
Episodes.Description: After Ben falls for Albedo's trap, Grandpa Max and Rook search all over the galaxy looking for Ben. Meanwhile he's secretly trapped on Khyber's hidden personal hunting preserve fighting Khyber's new pet that now wears the Nemetrix.

Episodes.Title: For a Few Brains More
Episodes.Description: Ben, Rook and Grandpa Max must stop Ultimate Albedo from absorbing all of Azmuth's profound knowledge and taking over the galaxy. Gwen and Kevin show up just in time to help with their struggle.

Episodes.Title: Max's Monster
Episodes.Description: Ben, Rook, and Grandpa Max have their hands full when Phil returns as a half-human, half-Terroranchula creature and starts absorbing all of the electricity and lightning in Bellwood. Phil seeks Max's help to tame the monster within.

Episodes.Title: Something Zombozo This Way Comes
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook must stop Zombozo and the Circus Freaks from turning everyone in Bellwood into zombie clowns!

Episodes.Title: Mystery, Incorporeal
Episodes.Description: An old enemy emerges while Ben and Rook visit Kevin and Gwen at college.

Episodes.Title: Bengeance Is Mine
Episodes.Description: Vilgax's former lackey Psyphon is elated when his master returns.

Episodes.Title: An American Benwolf in London
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook are called to London to investigate the Forever Knights' latest activities.

Episodes.Title: Animo Crackers
Episodes.Description: Dr. Animo from the future comes back to the present to help himself defeat Ben once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Rad Monster Party
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook enlist the help of intergalactic smuggler Rad Dudesman to fly them through the Anur System-the home of the monstrous aliens.

Episodes.Title: Charmed, I'm Sure
Episodes.Description: Still stranded on the monster planet Anur Transyl, Ben and Rook reluctantly team up with Charmcaster to take on Zs'Skayr.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire Strikes Back
Episodes.Description: Ben, Rook, Hobble and Rad Dudesman come face to face with the evil Lord Transyl, a vampire-like alien who can make anyone his loyal slave.

Episodes.Title: Catfight
Episodes.Description: The princess Looma and Attea are at odds over who gets to marry Ben.

Episodes.Title: Collect This
Episodes.Description: Ben finally meets the ones responsible for his intergalactic TV show, and the actor who makes Ben 10 more famous than Ben himself.

Episodes.Title: And Then There Were None
Episodes.Description: Vilgax and Eon team up to wipe out every Ben in every dimension.

Episodes.Title: And Then There Was Ben
Episodes.Description: Professor Paradox unites the good Bens from across all dimensions to take on Vilgax, Eon, and the evil Bens in the ultimate showdown.

Episodes.Title: The Vengers
Episodes.Description: Billy Billions, Kangaroo Kommando, and Captain Nemesis team up to take down Ben, and claim his place as protector of Bellwood?!?

Episodes.Title: Cough It Up
Episodes.Description: Psyphon and a gang of bounty hunters are after Argit, who is in possession of a dangerous weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Rooters of All Evil
Episodes.Description: Meet the Rooters, the Black Ops wing of the Plumbers from the Null Void. They've come looking for someone close to Ben, and they mean business.

Episodes.Title: Blukic and Driba Go to Area 51
Episodes.Description: A mysterious Galvan arrives and demands Blukic and Driba to give back a super powerful weapon needed to stop a threat to Earth.

Episodes.Title: No Honor Among Bros
Episodes.Description: Rook is under the influence of Fistrick's "bro" essence, and starts to act like a bro. Can he and Ben infiltrate an alien fight club to claim the Golden Fist?

Episodes.Title: Universe vs. Tennyson
Episodes.Description: Ben gets dragged into intergalactic court by the other Celestialsapiens for recreating the universe.

Episodes.Title: Weapon XI (1)
Episodes.Description: Kevin and Argit attempt to warn the Amalgam kids about the Rooters intentions. Meanwhile, Ben, Rook, and Gwen set off to find Kevin and land themselves in the Null Void.

Episodes.Title: Weapon XI (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rooters have seemingly turned Kevin and the Amalgam kids against Ben. Can Rook and Gwen help him overcome the opposition and escape the Null Void?

Episodes.Title: Clyde Five
Episodes.Description: Ben's country cousin Clyde Fife wants to become a hero like Ben.

Episodes.Title: Rook Tales
Episodes.Description: Master Kundo, Rook's former teacher is willing to save Revonnahgander traditions at any cost by preventing Rook's sister, Rook Sharr from going to the Plumber Academy so she wouldn't be able to become a Plumber.

Episodes.Title: Charm School
Episodes.Description: Charmcaster attacks Gwen at Freakin' University, wanting to obtain Hex's mystical Staff of Ages through any means necessary, while Kevin and Rook try to make Kevin's car completely indestructible so that nothing can destroy it.

Episodes.Title: The Ballad of Mr. Baumann
Episodes.Description: After Mr. Baumann, the grouchy storekeeper, realizes from Ben that his temper comes from being lonely he starts soul-searching. Eventually he stumbles across a secret not from this earth.

Episodes.Title: Fight at the Museum
Episodes.Description: When Ester invites Ben (who brings along Rook to the former's dismay) to a museum exhibit displaying alien artifacts, they encounter Ben's former crush Kai. When Ester discovers their relationship she immediately becomes jealous of her. The four of them are forced to team up, however, when a priceless exhibit that Kai put on display is stolen. Chrono Spanner also reappears again, this time trying to convince Ben that he's "destined" to marry Kai, to Ester's chagrin.

Episodes.Title: Breakpoint
Episodes.Description: Fistrick orchestrates a series of robberies while wearing ID masks programmed to make him and his compatriots to resemble Ben. When the real Ben discovers what's going on he decides to go undercover with Rook's help and investigate Fistrick's workout gym to find out what's going on. As this is all happening, Ben is struggling with his obsessive cravings for chili fries and meatball subs.

Episodes.Title: The Color of Monkey
Episodes.Description: With the help of the con-artist Simian, Argit starts a secure transport firm called "Argistix Securities" employing a group of Techadons as workers. Ben immediately becomes suspicious of Argit's business, considering the latter's history.

Episodes.Title: Vreedlemania
Episodes.Description: Pa Vreedle reunites with Ma for all-out, total cosmic destruction! Meanwhile, Rhomboid and Octagon tries to impress Ma and Pa Vreedle like Isosceles and Parallelogram Vreedle always does.

Episodes.Title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World (1)
Episodes.Description: A dangerous Chronosapien named Maltruant attempts to obtain total control over the time-space continuum with the help of an old relic called the Key to Time; Ben 23 is sent by the Azmuth of his dimension to Ben Tennyson's dimension in order for the latter to act as a "mentor" to the former.

Episodes.Title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World (2)
Episodes.Description: With the help of Dr. Psychobos, Ben 23 and Ben Tennyson successfully stage a breakout and a revolution in Mad Ben's labor camp.

Episodes.Title: From Hedorium to Eternity
Episodes.Description: 11-year-old Ben, Gwen, and friends go on the adventure of a lifetime in their own backyard.

Episodes.Title: Stuck on You
Episodes.Description: Khyber, aided by a booger-like Slimebiote named Skurd, attacks Ben & co, but the tables turn when Skurd gloms onto Ben!

Episodes.Title: Let's Do the Time War Again
Episodes.Description: Ben, Skurd, and Rook find themselves caught in an endless time loop as enemies from the future converge on Bellwood.

Episodes.Title: Secret of Dos Santos
Episodes.Description: Ben and Rook join Kai Green on a perilous alien relic hunt through South America.

Episodes.Title: Third Time's a Charm
Episodes.Description: Charmcaster traps Gwendolyn in Ledgerdomain to exact her revenge once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Final Countdown
Episodes.Description: While Rook is stuck on graveyard shift at Plumber HQ, his sensei Kundo returns as a cyborg to purge the galaxy of technological influence.

Episodes.Title: Malgax Attacks
Episodes.Description: Ben finally manages to rid himself of Skurd... just when he needs the Slime-Biot most.

Episodes.Title: Most Dangerous Game Show
Episodes.Description: Ben fights for his wife on an alien reality show.

Episodes.Title: End of an Era
Episodes.Description: The Time War races towards its dramatic conclusion, with the fate of the entire universe and everything in it since the very beginning of time resting in the hands of Ben 10!

Episodes.Title: A New Dawn
Episodes.Description: Ben, Rook and George Washington team up to battle an alien conqueror.

Episodes.Title: Round One
Episodes.Description: Round One of the Challenge.

Entries.Title: Ben 10
Entries.Description: Ben is tasked with cleaning the Rust Bucket, but when he is tricked into letting the villainous and vile Fly Guys steal it, he must chase them down before they create an unstoppable maggot monster.

Episodes.Title: The Filth
Episodes.Description: Ben is tasked with cleaning the Rust Bucket, but when he is tricked into letting the villainous and vile Fly Guys steal it, he must chase them down before they create an unstoppable maggot monster.

Episodes.Title: Waterfilter
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen, and Max's trip to Niagara Falls is cut short by the horrid Hydromanders - creatures menacing them and their fellow tourists.

Episodes.Title: The Ring Leader
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen's camping trip is interrupted by the emotionless Weatherheads - Gust-o, Hail-o, & Shock-o - but a malfunctioning Omnitrix firing out a mishmash of aliens may not be the forecast for success.

Episodes.Title: Riding the Storm Out
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen's camping trip is interrupted by the emotionless Weatherheads - Gust-o, Hail-o, & Shock-o - but a malfunctioning Omnitrix firing out a mishmash of aliens may not be the forecast for success.

Episodes.Title: The Clocktopus
Episodes.Description: Ben must overcome his fear of squids when the Steampunk super villain Steam Smythe attacks a construction site of Grandpa Max's favorite pier.

Episodes.Title: Take 10
Episodes.Description: While trying to film his own indie film, Ben accidentally allows the Bug Gang to go free and when he takes the fight to their hidden lair, Ben has to take on their narcissistic leader - the Ant Queen.

Episodes.Title: Growing Pains
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen are turned into babies by a weird nanny who wants to turn the world into a day care.

Episodes.Title: Shhh!
Episodes.Description: While chilling at a monastery with a no-noise policy, Ben can't keep quiet and accidentally awakens a dangerous Dragon hidden in a secret chamber below the hallowed halls - a job that might be too much for even Diamondhead.

Episodes.Title: Brief Career of Lucky Girl
Episodes.Description: When a wizard cos player gets his hands on a real magic wand at Comic Con, Ben enlists the help of Gwen (as Lucky Girl) to help stop Hex from retrieving it by tricking the wicked warlock into thinking she is a possessor of powerful magic herself.

Episodes.Title: Animo Farm
Episodes.Description: Ben stumbles into Dr. Animo's secret lab - now ruled by his superior mutants, the Alphas - and must help the lesser animals escape while stuck as Stinkfly.

Episodes.Title: Clown College
Episodes.Description: While tailgating at a State U. homecoming football game, Ben teams up with Grandpa Max's old college buddies to keep the crazy clown Zombozo from robbing the stadium blind at halftime.

Episodes.Title: Adventures in Babysitting
Episodes.Description: Gwen, Ben and Max encounter a family who are kind of their mirror selves.

Episodes.Title: Something I Ate
Episodes.Description: The Tennysons visit Fort Know, but it does not last long till Ben has to fight a monster.

Episodes.Title: Steam is the Word
Episodes.Description: In the heart of Silicon Valley, Ben has to stop Victorian villain, Steam Smythe, from getting an incredible power source sealed in a Tesla time capsule.

Episodes.Title: The Beast Inside
Episodes.Description: Dr. Animo returns with his newest invention, the 'Animerger'.

Episodes.Title: All Wet
Episodes.Description: No one believes Ben when he insists that one of the other patrons, waiting in line at the World of Wet Water Park, is the nefarious Frightwig, disguised as a common girl called Frida.

Episodes.Title: Villain Time
Episodes.Description: A man attempting to be a hero ends up misusing his abilities, and Ben has to stop him.

Episodes.Title: Drive You Crazy
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen decide to race against LaGrange when he crashes a race.

Episodes.Title: Tomorrow Today
Episodes.Description: The group visit the Buddy's Vision Of Tomorrow exhibit, where Steam Smythe hopes to take a secret weapon to rule the world.

Episodes.Title: Story, Bored
Episodes.Description: Hex returns for the large spellbook Grimoire of Archamada which contains a high-level spell that will make him more powerful than ever.

Episodes.Title: Hole in 10
Episodes.Description: While golfing, Ben must face a biker gang of mutated groundhogs.

Episodes.Title: Recipe for Disaster
Episodes.Description: When Ben puts out a fire as Wildvine, a trio of alien chiefs decide to eat him for lunch.

Episodes.Title: Rustbucket RIP
Episodes.Description: Ben finds a rare map in the historical village Oldeville. Billy Billions wants that map so he challenges Ben with his high-tech drones.

Episodes.Title: Freaky Gwen Ben
Episodes.Description: When Ben interferes with malicious magician Hex's quest for the earth-moving Titan Gloves at a swap meet, he switches bodies with Gwen forcing him to walk a mile in her shoes and vice-versa!

Episodes.Title: Ben 24hrs
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen want to stay awake in Adrenaland, a theme park that is 24/7 open. Thinking that with his alien abilities he can stay awake, things get worse.

Episodes.Title: Bright Lights, Black Hearts
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Max stop by the graveyard set of a movie, The Unalivers. Before long, Ben discovers its leading role, Michael Morningstar, is a energy-absorbing vampire.

Episodes.Title: Don't Laze Me, Bro
Episodes.Description: When a new enemy causes Gwen and Max to become super-lazy, it's up to Ben to snap them out of it and finally get serious in order to put things back to normal.

Episodes.Title: Don't Let the Bass Drop
Episodes.Description: Gwen and Ben are excited to attend an Earth Day EDM concert in Portland until the show is hijacked by the sound/music/audio-manipulating villain, Lord Decibel.

Episodes.Title: Bad Penny
Episodes.Description: Ben hangs out with his weird former-babysitter named Penny when they arrive at a pig festival while Maurice and Sydney create a helium weapon for their next big heist.

Episodes.Title: Zombozo-Land
Episodes.Description: Zombozo returns with the Circus Freaks, (Frightwig, and 2 new members, Thumbskull and Acid Breath) with a new plan to turn everyone into clowns like him.

Episodes.Title: Forgeti
Episodes.Description: During a hunt for the fabled 'Forgeti', (who Gwen is fascinated and obsessed with), Ben and Gwen face Dr. Animo once again when he kidnaps Max for his latest experiment.

Episodes.Title: Max to the Max
Episodes.Description: When Maurice and Sydney accidentally split Max into 100 dumb clones of himself, Ben must find a way to switch him back without getting divided as well, while Gwen is forced to babysit the Maxes.

Episodes.Title: Cutting Corners
Episodes.Description: Ben wants to earn some money by mowing Bob's lawn. He rebuilds the lawnmower into a super fast-mowing machine, but in doing so he angers the little stubborn gnome neighbors.

Episodes.Title: Xingo
Episodes.Description: Ben's favorite cartoon character, Xingo, comes out of TV into the real world when Upgrade tampers with the TV satellite.

Episodes.Title: Scared Silly
Episodes.Description: Ben needs to pretend that he is not scared when staying in a haunted hotel.

Episodes.Title: Need for Speed
Episodes.Description: Touring Yellowstone National Park, Ben uncovers a plot by Lagrange who wants to digout an old treasure from below the national park.

Episodes.Title: Omni-Tricked (1)
Episodes.Description: Ben's trip to Portland with his family is interrupted by the arrival of a brand new, eleventh alien, Gax, as he fights another one of Dr. Animo's monsters. But when the Omnitrix starts behaving strangely, Ben begins to transform from one alien to another without being able to stop.

Episodes.Title: Omni-Tricked (2)
Episodes.Description: As the Omnitrix is ​​still uncontrollable, Ben asks a mysterious friend of Max to repair it. But when three bounty hunters, Sixsix, Kraab, and Tetrax land to recover the watch, Ben has to try and fight them despite his current predicament.

Episodes.Title: Omni-Tricked (3)
Episodes.Description: Ben heads far into the forest to prevent his unpredictable transformations from causing damage. Meanwhile, Vilgax, who seems to be the same species as Gax, lands nearby. The latter helps Ben discover his powers, but he quickly realizes that this new friend is in fact an opponent.

Episodes.Title: Omni-Tricked (4)
Episodes.Description: After his meeting with Vilgax, Ben continues to transform rapidly without stopping or be able to revert to human form. While Vilgax tries to take the energy of a volcano to recharge his ship and return home, Ben gets the idea to "update" the Omnitrix and thus save the planet from his enemy. But what did he do exactly?

Episodes.Title: And Then There Were 10
Episodes.Description: Average kid, ten year old Ben Tennyson, his Grandpa Max and his cousin Gwen's summer of adventure takes an odd turn when Ben discovers a watch like object  that has been jettisoned from alien spacecraft high above the Earth.

Episodes.Title: Washington B.C.
Episodes.Description: Ben must fight Dr. Animo, a crazed scientist who has a DNA-altering device.

Episodes.Title: The Krakken
Episodes.Description: Ben has his hands full with a giant sea monster and an evil poacher.

Episodes.Title: Permanent Retirement
Episodes.Description: Ben must rescue his aunt and grandfather when they are held hostage by shape-shifting aliens.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: Ben is pursued by three bounty hunters sent by Vilgax to steal the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: Tourist Trap
Episodes.Description: Ben accidentally releases creatures made of electric energy and must use his own powers to recapture them.

Episodes.Title: Kevin 11
Episodes.Description: Ben meets a mutant who can absorb any form of energy and may be after the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: The Alliance
Episodes.Description: Ben clashes with a female gang member who's become part cyborg.

Episodes.Title: Last Laugh
Episodes.Description: Ben discovers an evil circus that's headed by a psychic vampire clown named Zombozo.

Episodes.Title: Lucky Girl
Episodes.Description: Ben battles a sorcerer who possesses a number of charms, and Gwen suddenly becomes a superhero when one of the charms falls into her hands.

Episodes.Title: A Small Problem
Episodes.Description: Ben gets revenge on an amusement-park attendant who said he was too small to go on a ride.

Episodes.Title: Side Effects
Episodes.Description: Ben's summer cold causes strange physical changes in his alien personas.

Episodes.Title: Secrets
Episodes.Description: Vilgax tries to get the Omnitrix for himself while Grandpa Max's strange past becomes known, causing a showdown between Vilgax and the Tennyson family.

Episodes.Title: Out to Launch
Episodes.Description: On a visit to Cape Canaveral, the Tennyson Trio attend the launch of an experimental space plane, but when Vilgax hijacks the ship, Ben must stop him from weaponizing the shuttle.

Episodes.Title: Can I Keep It?
Episodes.Description: After stumbling upon a cute cat-dog-rabbit creature hybrid, or Cadobbit, Ben ignores Grandpa Max's advice and sneaks the animal onto the Rust Bucket.

Episodes.Title: Battle at Biggie Box
Episodes.Description: During the Biggie Box sale, Ben enlists Simon Sez to help him find Max and get back to the register with his toys before the sale ends and Billy Billions buys them instead.

Episodes.Title: Bon Voyage
Episodes.Description: Aboard the SS Pettigrew, on its final voyage, Ben must not only battle seasickness, but Steam Smythe, who looks to use his mechanical creatures to sink the steamship's replacement.

Episodes.Title: Mayhem in Mascot
Episodes.Description: After their attempt to get a photo with every storefront mascot is foiled, Ben and Gwen sneak out at night to get their photo taken with the wooden bear totem known as Yawk.

Episodes.Title: Screamcatcher
Episodes.Description: When a cavity forces Ben to the dentist, his day gets even worse when the malevolent magician Hex uses a nearby dream catcher to bring Ben's fears to life.

Episodes.Title: Vote Zombozo
Episodes.Description: When the Rust Bucket must tune-up in the same town as Zombozo's latest campaign trail stop, Ben soon discovers the clown is using his speeches to hypnotize then rob the town.

Episodes.Title: Animorphosis
Episodes.Description: As the Tennyson trio dig up dinosaur fossils in the Badlands, Ben is unaware that Vilgax and Dr. Amino have teamed up to steal alien DNA from within the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: The 11th Alien (1)
Episodes.Description: Ben is trying to save a city from a mudslide when Vilgax shows up with a warning about a new alien coming out of Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: The 11th Alien (2)
Episodes.Description: The new alien has dangerous powers, and that worries Ben more and more.

Episodes.Title: High Stress Express
Episodes.Description: During a live feed of a transcontinental bullet train, La Grange enters the picture to outrace the train, but Ben joins in on the fun and will stop at nothing to come out on top.

Episodes.Title: Creature Feature
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen must save the drive-in when the evil magician Hex brings a movie monster to life.

Episodes.Title: Drone On
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen are in a highly competitive paper airplane war, but when alien-tech drones bombard the Rust Bucket, the cousins must work together to ground the aerial attack

Episodes.Title: Safari Sa'Bad
Episodes.Description: On their trip to Adrenaworld West, Ben takes a detour on a jungle cruise and finds himself hunted by the evil Tim Buktu.

Episodes.Title: The Nature of Things
Episodes.Description: While sightseeing at the Geyser Gulch National Park, the Tennyson trio uncovers Steam Smythe's steam-powered generator and must shut it down before it overloads the power grid.

Episodes.Title: Assault on Pancake Palace
Episodes.Description: When Max enters a pancake eating contest at the famous Pancake Palace, Ben finds the Bugg Brothers and must stop them before they obtain an endless supply of Pancake Palace pancakes.

Episodes.Title: Bomzobo Lives
Episodes.Description: During a routine trip to the DMV, Max takes a driving test to renew his license, but a disguised Zombozo hijacks the role of instructor.

Episodes.Title: King Koil
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen volunteer for a day at the Repto Ranch. There they meet the evil King Koil, who takes control of the reptiles in the facility to create an army. Both of them must overcome their fear of snakes and save the animals that the King Koil has released

Episodes.Title: The Sound and the Furry
Episodes.Description: As Team Tennyson leaves the Frozen Man Festival, Lord Decibel takes center stage to threaten the festival-goers, creating an avalanche if his ransom isn't paid.

Episodes.Title: All Koiled Up
Episodes.Description: When Ben grows impatient with the snail like pace of gardening, he goes Omni-Enhaanced Overflow to pick up the pace and accidentally floods the community rock garden. But once a giant sink hole appears and frees King Koil and his Kimodo Dragon from below, Ben must quickly make up for his mistake and capture the baddies if he is to save the coastal city of Bayburgh.

Episodes.Title: Reststop Roustabout
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max stop in the middle of the Midwest. While Ben makes himself comfortable in the mobile home with his tablet, Max and Gwen go outside to get some fresh air. When Gwen and Max are drawn into the hunt for a Jackalope, a mythical animal that looks like a rabbit with antlers, the mysterious animal soon starts tormenting Ben. But is it real or a trick of Ben's tablet-ladden mind?

Episodes.Title: That’s the Stuff
Episodes.Description: A mysterious alien substance copies Ben's appearance and powers while Ben is visiting a space museum, and quickly assumes the shape of other people, leaving the Tennysons to find a way to reveal who is actually the mysterious substance. Note: This episode is a parody of The Thing.

Episodes.Title: Half-Sies
Episodes.Description: During a trip to the Lake of the Ozarks, Ben and Gwen squabble over Ben's unnecessary half-birthday celebration; when Max gets word of a suspicious rockslide nearby, the cousins must put aside their differences if they are to rescue trapped miners.

Episodes.Title: Xingo’s Back
Episodes.Description: Left to entertain himself, Ben stumbles upon a Xingo arcade game and goes OE-Shock Rock to power it up; when the game receives too much juice, Xingo leaps out into the real world.

Episodes.Title: Bounty Ball
Episodes.Description: While Gwen listens to a lecture on the Transcontinental Railroad, Ben sneaks away to the gift shop; Gwen must relay the information she learned on the train to help Ben escape the Bounty Hunters.

Episodes.Title: The Charm Offensive
Episodes.Description: While hanging out at Fort Knox, Gwen grows jealous of Ben's aliens getting all the glamour and attention. But when she discovers that a new villainess, Charmcaster, is really Michael Morningstar's last remaining fangirl turned witch (from the end tag in season 1), Gwen must withstand attacks from both her and Morningstar, and prove herself as a valued member of Team Tennyson.

Episodes.Title: Fear the Fogg
Episodes.Description: As Max attempts to get Ben and Gwen to the Four Corners Monument before sunset, an ominous fog bank engulfs the roadway and forces Max to drive at a snails pace, but once The Fog comes to life and attacks the Rust Bucket for its battery, Team Tennyson must work together if they are to navigate to safety.

Episodes.Title: The Feels
Episodes.Description: While Gwen and Max are enamored by wintertime fun during the summer, Ben isn't interested until the Weatherheads attack, intent on feeding off the emotional energy caused by destroying the town.

Episodes.Title: Super-Villain Team-Up
Episodes.Description: After a lull in alien antics, a restless Ben suggests to Max and Gwen that he might be a better hero if he went solo, but once Vilgax enlists the help of Zombozo to build a giant hypno-mechanism to hypnotize the entire world, Ben must rethink his strategy if he is to defeat the evil alliance between them.

Episodes.Title: Past Aliens Present
Episodes.Description: Ben is shocked to discover that Steam Smythe has built steampunk robots capable of masquerading as and matching Ben's aliens, hoping to discredit the hero's ever-growing popularity and simultaneously helping his crusade against modern technology.

Episodes.Title: Chicken Nuggets of Wisdom
Episodes.Description: When Ben and Max get into an argument, Ben goes Heatblast to blow off steam against Max’s wishes; but once Dr. Animo spots him and subsequently turns Max into a chicken, it’s up to Ben to save his Grandpa and stop Dr. Animo, now using a bat-based monster with sonic screams.

Episodes.Title: Ye Olde Laser Duel
Episodes.Description: As team Tennyson admires the modern train station, Ben sniffs out one of Steam Smythe's robots holding up the line. Once the fed up villain tricks Ben into accepting a duel, the fate of the Omnitrix hangs in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Double Hex
Episodes.Description: While bird watching at Pinnacles National Park, Gwen and Ben get into a competition of who can spot more birds first, but once a forest fire interrupts their fun, Team Tennyson must hurry if they are to save the bird population.

Episodes.Title: Ben Again and Again
Episodes.Description: After Billy Billions' efforts to carve his face onto Mount Rushmore with a laser are thwarted by Ben, the billionaire brat turns his focus on removing Ben from the Omnitrix.

Episodes.Title: Dreamtime
Episodes.Description: After a series of recurring nightmares affect his sleep, Ben refuses to open up to Max and Gwen about what's bothering him. Before long, the entire team is trapped in his nightmares as well, putting them up against Zombozo in a nightmare world.

Episodes.Title: Innervasion Part 1: Message in a Boxcar (1)
Episodes.Description: Part One: Message in a Boxcar: Ben and Gwen partake in a box car race, however the race is cut short when a large robot attacks. Worse still, Ben is hearing voices in his head while transformed.

Episodes.Title: Innervasion Part 2: Call the Dream Police (2)
Episodes.Description: Part Two: Call the Dream Police: After defeating the Warbot and discovering Vilgax inside, Ben's "secret voices" only worsen and begin affecting his sleep, but once Gwen discovers a sleepwalking Ben using missing items from the campsite to create his own massive Junkbot, it is up to Ben to stop his own creation.

Episodes.Title: Innervasion Part 3: Strange Bedfellows (3)
Episodes.Description: Part Three: Strange Bedfellows: After the Junkbot shoots the Omnitrix and it begins glowing neon-blue, an imprisoned Vilgax explains it is now a gateway through which the Fulmini Empire will invade Earth, but the only way to stop them is from within the Omnitrix, so Ben must team up with the ultimate baddie if he is to save his planet.

Episodes.Title: Innervasion Part 4: Mind Over Alien Matter (4)
Episodes.Description: Part Four: Mind Over Alien Matter: While inside the Omnitrix, Ben and Vilgax must work together if they are to close the gateway, but once the Fulmini leader - the High Override - appears, even that might not be enough. Luckily, help arrives in the form of a being calling itself Glitch!

Episodes.Title: Innervasion Part 5: High Override (5)
Episodes.Description: Part Five: High Override: While Ben struggles to avoid the High Override's mind control, Max and Gwen enter the Omnitrix to lend a hand, but once they find Ben is not who he seems, Max and Gwen must pull out all the stops if they are to get Ben back in time to save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: After the battle with Vilgax, Grandpa Max retells his story to Ben about his past. He was with an organization that was not known to exist, referred to as "The Plumbers," a group of people who track down extraterrestrial life. Meanwhile, they meet Phil, an old partner of Grandpa Max. But they soon find out that he steals a device, called the Null Void Projector, to selfishly use it to make money by appearing to capture aliens that he alone released himself.

Episodes.Title: The Big Tick
Episodes.Description: At Yellowstone Park, Ben and Gwen inadvertently discover a new form on the Omnitrix: Cannon Bolt, an armadillo-like alien that Ben isn't too fond of. Soon after, a meteor comes crashing down to the park, containing a planet-devouring, tick-like alien. On top of that, three other aliens arrive with it, and worship it as their savior, the "Great One." Powerless to stop the planet-eater with his regular forms, Ben must rely on a new form he knows nothing about.

Episodes.Title: Framed
Episodes.Description: At a city, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max are waiting outside a video game store to purchase the newly-released Sumo Slammer video game. Gwen and Grandpa Max go the book store, but when they return to check on him, Four Arms comes out of the store by force. They return to the RV, and find that Ben is already there. Gwen yells at Ben for what he's done, but he has no clue of what she's talking about. But as she gives direct evidence that Four Arms was attacking the city, Ben heads out to find the perpetrator, using the identity of his aliens to ruin his current reputation as a hero.

Episodes.Title: Gwen 10
Episodes.Description: In this "how 'bout?" episode, Gwen gets the Omnitrix and the power that comes with it.

Episodes.Title: Grudge Match
Episodes.Description: In the middle of nowhere, Ben, as Diamond Head, fights Kevin 11, who is still in his mutated form. As they fight, they are taken to a ship, where a battle between different aliens are held. But when a mechanical droid named Slix decides to create a bond with Ben and Kevin as a team, they immediately turn his idea down. But with no choice, they must find a way out. Will Ben and Kevin learn the importance of teamwork?

Episodes.Title: The Galactic Enforcers
Episodes.Description: At a museum, Ben sits and reads a comic, daydreaming about himself as a super hero. As Gwen interrupts him, she is not happy how Ben treats the artwork. His day has been a bore, but when an alien vessel arrives, an alien named Volcanus and the bounty hunter Sixsix come to pursue the Biocenthium alloy to complete a mixture with Element X to create a bomb, strong enough to destroy a whole solar system. Suddenly, Ben meets The Galactic Enforcers, a group of three who serve in protecting the galaxy under the conduct code. Ben is intrigued by their heroic appearance, but are they really something to be looking up to?

Episodes.Title: Camp Fear
Episodes.Description: When Ben and Gwen argue over a birthday party to occur in the next few months, Grandpa Max is distracted by their quarreling and almost hits a young boy camper. To ensure the boy's life, they head to Camp Opinicon, only to find no people around. As they investigate the premises, they find twins, whom were also hiding from something that may have a connection to the lifeless camp. Grandpa Max readies to leave the area with the children, only to find that the RV's engine is clogged with a mysterious fungus. While the kids take in shelter in a nearby cabin, Grandpa Max is captured. Now Ben must come to the rescue to discover a new alien form, as well as a way to destroy the evil alien Myceloid Monsters and their Fungal Master, and learn the benefits of what sharing can do.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Weapon
Episodes.Description: In Texas, a group of men discover a mysterious mask belonging to Ah Puch, the Mayan god of death and destruction. The mask is the key to the ultimate weapon in the world, known as the Sword of Ekchuah. However, when Grandpa Max and his grandkids learn that the mask is discovered, he impatiently sets out to obtain the mask, so that it does not fall in the wrong hands. Unfortunately, they find out that Enoch of The Organization is after it as well. The kids worry of how Grandpa Max has become, but with Enoch in the way, will Grandpa Max find the sword before him?

Episodes.Title: Tough Luck
Episodes.Description: Hex's niece, Charmcaster, enters the underground prison he's held at to release him out of his cell. With her help, Hex was able to regain most of his powers after being given his magical staff. Meanwhile, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max head to a magic convention held in Las Vegas, and in there, Gwen finds the legendary Keystone of Bazell. With it, she gains the powers of Lucky Girl once again, but will it last after finding out that Hex and his niece are after it?

Episodes.Title: They Lurk Below
Episodes.Description: Our heroes ride a jet belonging to Grandpa Max's old Friend, Donovan Grand Smith, who owns an underwater resort. At the entrance, they receive a warm welcome from Donovan himself, though they also meet with his grandson, Edwin, who didn't seem to be excited about their guests. Later, when Edwin, Ben, and Gwen enter the Undersea Manta Ray, a giant submarine, they encounter strange aliens that threatened to destroy the whole resort. While the kids find a way to cooperate with each other to find the source that lures them in, Donovan himself learns a few lessons in how to bond better with his grandson.

Episodes.Title: Ghostfreaked Out
Episodes.Description: A terrorizing nightmare of Ghostfreak is half the trouble for an unnerved Ben, as a tour of an important academy that Gwen wishes to attend is disturbed by the uncanny alien's manifestations and the antics of Acid Breath, Frightwig, and Thumbskull.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
Episodes.Description: The Tennysons arrive at a swamp, where a festivities of Gatorfest start first thing the next day. Gwen finds Ben playing around with the Omnitrix, and she warns him that it may create unusual problems. Without heeding Max and Gwen's warning, he pops the face out, and the Omnitrix acts up. Right away, something was wrong, though it was gone unnoticed, at least, until the next day. Gator-fest was going along well, but the giant frog of Dr. Animo comes in to disrupt it. Dr. Animo has returned, and he wants to take revenge on Ben. But when Ben goes alien, he transforms into a hybrid alien with unbalanced attributes. Will Ben ever learn his lesson in listening for a change?

Episodes.Title: Back With a Vengeance
Episodes.Description: The Megacruiser flies solo in space, and inside Kevin examines the giant ice block found in space. Inside the mass, held Vilgax, and Kevin underestimated his current situation. He was very much alive and well, and they soon create a partnership after learning that they were both after the same person. On Earth, Ben plays around with the Omnitrix, hoping to find a better way of controlling it. Eventually, he finds the master control of the Omnitrix, giving him the ability to alternate between aliens, as well as prolong his duration with a form. Although his discovery has given him a stronger advantage, will it be enough to stop the danger that lies ahead?

Episodes.Title: Omni-Copped
Episodes.Description: When Grandpa Max’s engineer buddy Phil Billings gifts Team Tennyson the Omni-Copter, a state of the art flying vehicle that can transport the Rustbucket for overseas adventures, Steam Smythe takes to the skies to ground Ben and company’s first test flight; but unbeknownst to our heroes, Smythe was sent to battle Ben’s latest alien forms by a mysterious, powerful enemy: the Forever Knight.

Episodes.Title: This One Goes to 11
Episodes.Description: During one last stop by a toy store before Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max's maiden voyage across the Atlantic, Ben runs into an old bully, Kevin 11, who now has new powers. He's able to transform into aliens just like Ben, such as the "bootleg" doppelganger of Cannon-bolt—Wrecking-bolt!

Episodes.Title: Rath of Con
Episodes.Description: Back stateside, Ben can't get into a cat cosplay competition, Top Tail, without a cat costume of his own; but when he goes Rath, a new cat-like alien with an attitude, Ben's newfound wild side quickly becomes much more than he bargained for, and must learn to hold in his rage.

Episodes.Title: Poles Apart
Episodes.Description: When Ben, Gwen, and Max try to travel to the South Pole, magnetic disturbances cause the instruments to malfunction and take them to the North Pole instead, where they find that two criminal scientist brothers, Polar and Solar Twain, have plans to swap the magnetic poles of the Earth, unleashing technologic and atmospheric disturbance unless the world pays a ransom.

Episodes.Title: Show Don't Tell
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max arrive at a Native American park to see the Ayasha Plinths, an ancient Stonehenge-like rock formation. But when Hex arrives, he casts a spell that causes everyone to interpret what he says as a lie, turning Hex into a hero planning on creating the Golem of Ayasha.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Zombozo-Zone!
Episodes.Description: During medieval times, Team Tennyson must fight to remember that they're not in the past at all, but actually at a Renaissance-ques fair, where Zombozo has hypnotized its guests into thinking they live in the past.

Episodes.Title: Bridge Out
Episodes.Description: After an overpass collapses on the highway, Team Tennyson is trapped in a traffic jam along with Simon Sez and his family. But when Ben and Simon team up to tackle the gridlock together, Simon only makes matters worse.

Episodes.Title: Beach Heads
Episodes.Description: After traveling to Tampa Beach, Florida, Team Tennyson hopes to get some much-needed rest & relaxation, but the Weatherheads have other plans that Ben must thwart: a solar powered tower so that they never worry about losing power.

Episodes.Title: Charm School's Out
Episodes.Description: During a family cookout at a forest campsite, Charmcaster uses her magic to switch places with Gwen, but when Ben catches "Charmcaster" sneaking about, he attacks, unaware it's actually his cursed cousin.

Episodes.Title: Billy Bajillions
Episodes.Description: In Aspen, Colorado, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max are on a hike to find the Forgeti, but when they realize they've stumbled upon Billy Billions own "Winter in July" ski resort, Ben must battle Billy, with an assist from the Forgeti itself.

Episodes.Title: Franken-Fight
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen's recreational drive in the Rustbuggy takes a turn when Glitch bonds with part of Kevin 11's version of 'Upgrade' named Bootleg. Not only does this cause the Rustbuggy to mutate into a metallic monster, but it makes Glitch become a speed demon who kidnaps Gwen!

Episodes.Title: Buggin' the Bugs
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson wonders what the Bugg Brothers are up to when the group runs into them while vacationing at the Chrysalen Institute.

Episodes.Title: Which Watch
Episodes.Description: After a battle with Kevin gets cut short, Ben turns his attention to one-upping Gwen at Space Camp. But, when Kevin returns with his sights strangely set on his cousin, our hero discovers who is really behind it all: Charmcaster!

Episodes.Title: Baby Buktu
Episodes.Description: When attacked in the jungle, Team Tennyson is saved by a toddler who looks eerily similar to Tim Buktu, but when they discover it really a pint sized version of the nefarious globetrotter, Ben knows there's another threat looming: Nanny Nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Them's Fightin' Words!
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson discovers a Hartfield-McJoy (a parody of the Hatfield-McCoy feud) reenactment in the cornfield next door, but when Hex resurrects the ghosts of the real feuding families, Ben must find a way to bring them together in order to save the day.

Episodes.Title: Mutiny for the Bounty
Episodes.Description: While Phil and Grandpa Max tune-up the Omni-Copter, Ben takes the Rustbuggy off road, but when he is suddenly captured by Tetrax, our hero must not only escape but avoid the wrath of the double-crossed Kraab and Sixsix!

Episodes.Title: The Chupaca-bro
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson discovers that a small village's goats are being terrorized by the legendary Chupacabra, but when Ben realizes it's actually Dr. Animo, our hero must thwart the dastardly doctor.

Episodes.Title: Buggy Out
Episodes.Description: After winning a Sumo Slammers Champion belt, Ben returns to the Rustbucket to find it in the arms of Kevin, but when his rival hijacks the Rustbuggy instead, our hero must stop at nothing to get back what belongs to him. Eventually, though, Kevin and Ben must work together to fend off an attack from the Forever Knight, who is angered at Kevin's refusal to follow orders.

Episodes.Title: Introducing Kevin 11
Episodes.Description: At a local swap meet, Ben instead sets his sights on a Sumo Slammer collectible, but when Kevin takes it for himself, our hero must get it back by overcoming Kevin's secret weapon: an 11th alien named Bashmouth.

Episodes.Title: Four by Four
Episodes.Description: During their visit to the Twin City, Ben and Gwen sign up for some Laser Town awesomeness, but when Ben is teamed up with Kevin, the two must overcome their differences if they are to end up on top, especially since Gwen has been paired with the mysterious Fang. To make things worse, a hit from a laser causes Kevin to be trapped in the form of his version of Four Arms named "Quad Smack", and he needs to find a way to fix his Antitrix in order to change back.

Episodes.Title: Moor Fogg
Episodes.Description: When Team Tennyson's trip takes them to Scotland, they plan on visiting the various locales of Scotland, but their plans are foiled when the Fogg returns to exact its revenge.

Episodes.Title: King of the Castle
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson finds out about their British ancestry, so they visit their relative's estate, but mysterious events convince Ben that the place is haunted. However, it turns out that Kevin Levin has followed them to Britain, and showcases three new alien forms based on those Ben has lost: Thornblade (Wildvine), Undertow (Overflow), and Dark Matter (Grey Matter).

Episodes.Title: Speechless on the Seine
Episodes.Description: When Ben and the others take a trip to Paris, Ben, impatient and uninterested, accidentally gets himself locked out of the Omni-Copter. To make things worse, he can't communicate with the people of France, and Ben ends up in the clutches of Zombozo, who hypnotizes him into being unable to speak.

Episodes.Title: Don’t Touch
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson checks out a Samurai Museum in Tokyo. However, Ben finally comes face-to-face with the Forever Knight when he steals a valuable sword from the museum and starts a chase across the rooftops.

Episodes.Title: Big in Japan
Episodes.Description: Tim Buktu returns, seemingly reformed after saving people from a dragon in the streets of Tokyo. But the Tennysons suspect there's more to Tim's actions than meets the eye.

Episodes.Title: Cyber Slammers
Episodes.Description: In front of a biggie box in Japan, Ben waits in an eternally long line for the release of Cyber Slammers, the brand new Sumo Slammers video game. Soon Ben has to save the whole store - and not in front of the gaming enthusiastic customers, but before Steam Smythe, who wants to equip a big Mech-suit with Steam Punk powers.

Episodes.Title: Big Ben 10
Episodes.Description: While Ben and his family visit the Big Ben Clock tower, the Bugg Brothers once again set up a crazy plan: they want to shrink Big Ben's bell to steal it!

Episodes.Title: LaGrange Murraille
Episodes.Description: Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max walk along the Great Wall of China, but almost have their adventure spoiled by racers LaGrange and Vin Ethanol, who want to try a daredevil jump over the wall.

Episodes.Title: Lickety Split
Episodes.Description: When a mysterious electrical storm downs the Omni-Copter at the Equator, Team Tennyson soon discovers Solar & Polar are behind it, but when Ben accidentally combines the two into a more powerful Uni-Twin, our hero must think fast if he is going to save the planet.

Episodes.Title: The Claws of the Cat
Episodes.Description: While taking in the sights and sounds of a Rio de Jenaro music festival, Ben bristles at Gwen's suggestion that she be his new sidekick, but when the festival is threaten by the strong supersonic waves of Lord Decibel, our hero must lean on help from Gwen and Max in order to defeat him.

Episodes.Title: Roundabout: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Forever Knight finally assembles his Round Table of young but powerful Knights, including Ben, in order to conquer all of history.

Episodes.Title: Roundabout: Part 2
Episodes.Description: Forever Knight finally assembles his Round Table of young but powerful Knights, including Ben, in order to conquer all of history.

Episodes.Title: Cirque Us
Episodes.Description: Ben is the guest of honor at an upcoming Gala, but when the cirque entertainment turns out to be a disguised Zombozo, Ben must not only defeat the evil clown but his mysterious new sidekick, Pirouette!

Episodes.Title: Forever Road
Episodes.Description: During a drag race, Ben hopes to stay neck and neck with Vin Ethanol and La Grange as XLR8, but when his watch keeps shorting out, our hero must get creative if he is to keep up with his fast and furious foes.

Episodes.Title: The Bentathlon
Episodes.Description: After stuffing their faces with gyros, Team Tennyson visit to Greece in the Omni-Copter, but when they are suddenly captured by the Forever Knight mid-flight, Ben ends up in a coliseum, where he is pitted against old foes: Iron Kyle, Queen Bee, and the Ground Hawgs!

Episodes.Title: Prey or Play
Episodes.Description: After receiving an exclusive ticket to Adrenaland, Ben leaves behind Grandpa Max and Gwen to enjoy the perks of being the parks only attendant, but when he learns he’s not alone, our hero must now contend with Billy Billions, the only kid who could afford the park's price of admission.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Scare-Crow
Episodes.Description: During a visit to the farm of Penny Bennyson's grandfather, Team Tennyson is haunted by a living scarecrow, but when Ben discovers that Aristocrow is behind it all, our hero must defeat Aristocrow's master, Steam Smythe, if he is to save his cousin's farm.

Episodes.Title: The Night Ben Tennyson Came to Town
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson travels to Wheeler, “the liveliest mining town on Route 66”, but when Ben becomes paranoid that the Forever Knight is out to get him, he must try to convince his family while also stopping his new foe from destroying the town.

Episodes.Title: And Xingo Was His Name-O
Episodes.Description: When a new Xingo app mysteriously appears on Gwen's tablet, Ben activates it despite his cousin's disapproval, springing a trap that transports Ben in the animated world and Xingo into the real world.

Episodes.Title: Fear in the Family
Episodes.Description: Ben and Gwen can’t wait for the Omni-Copter to arrive at the Great Pyramids, but when bad weather disrupts their flight, they soon come face-to-face with the Fogg and its offspring.

Episodes.Title: Xingo Nation
Episodes.Description: Kevin gives Xingo a power up – setting him loose to wreak havoc on other TV shows – and it is up to Ben to stop them both.

Episodes.Title: Heads of the Family
Episodes.Description: Team Tennyson stops in at a fringe family reunion, and Ben encounters a whole lot more than kooky cousins— namely, Kevin and the Bugg Brothers, whose latest invention sparks a series of head-swaps between all parties.

Episodes.Title: My Bodyguard
